title_en: RELAY — TELSTAR, SYNCOM & THE GEOSTATIONARY IDEA
description: An interactive field guide to communications satellites: Potočnik's and Clarke's orbit that keeps pace with the turning Earth, Echo 1's 30-metre balloon, Telstar's 12-to-44-minute passes over Andover and the radiation that killed it, Syncom 2's figure eight and Syncom 3's Tokyo Olympics, Early Bird, the Soviet Molniya orbit at 63.4°, and the crowded geostationary belt of today, with its 0.24-second delay.
og: Why 35,786 km? One sidereal day from Kepler's third law, Telstar's real passes over Andover against a dish that never moves, Syncom's figure eight, Molniya's 63.4° and the geostationary belt's footprint and delay, interactive and checked against NASA, ESA and CelesTrak data.
brand: RELAY — TECHNICAL FIELD GUIDE / ТЕХНИЧЕСКИЙ СПРАВОЧНИК
